newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FINANCIAL MKTS SERVED BY THIRD LOCAL BROKER.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FINANCIAL MKTS SERVED BY THIRD LOCAL BROKER.

text.p: A third local brokerage firm, Athens Money Brokers, has recently started to serve Greece's fast growing money, forex and bond markets.
The new brokerage is headed by Anastasios Petroutsas, formerly treasurer at Citibank, Athens and Panagiotis Speliotopoulos, a senior broker.

"Athens Money Brokers will differ from its competitors in becoming an advisor, a friend and a colleague of dealers in the interbank markets in their day-to-day business," general manager Speliotopoulos told Reuters.
Athens Money Brokers has a share capital of 100 million drachmas and is offering the full range of services and products in the interbank market.
"Through increased volume in local and cross-border deals, our operations shall contribute to the support of the drachma," said Speliotopoulos.

Due for an official opening in early September 1997, Athens Money Brokers is currently staffed by 10 experienced dealers and brokers, most of whom had a stint at the other local brokerages, Sigma Money Brokers and Haramis-Cox. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
